notes: Texas held its primary on March 3, 2026 — most races already have nominees or runoff matchups set. Several key races (US Senate, AG, Railroad Commissioner) go to May 26 runoff. This inventory covers races that would appear on a ballot for the given address. District-level assignments for state House/Senate are best-guess based on geographic research — the address is in east Austin (Manor/Pflugerville area).

usCongressional.notes: TX-37 is the Austin/Travis County-centered district created after 2020 census. East Austin 78721 is squarely in Travis County. After 2025 redistricting, District 35 was moved out of Travis County — TX-37 absorbed most of Austin proper.

texasStateSenate.notes: Sarah Eckhardt (D) represents SD-14 covering Austin. Her term runs through 2029 — NOT up in 2026. She is running for Comptroller but does not vacate the seat.

texasStateHouse.notes: HD-46 represented by Sheryl Cole (D) covers east Austin, Manor, Pflugerville. Webberville Rd is in east Austin. Could also be HD-49 (central Austin, Gina Hinojosa's former seat) — exact boundary depends on redistricting. Need to verify via wrm.capitol.texas.gov.

usSenate.notes: High-profile race. Talarico polling slightly ahead of both GOP candidates. One of the most competitive TX Senate races in decades.
